bibl.title: Curatores in Two Papyri from Heidelberg
bibl.seg: W. Graham Claytor & Dan Deac, Curatores in Two Papyri from Heidelberg.
Pylon. Editions and Studies of Ancient Texts 4 (2023) §1-21, figg.
bibl.note: 1. P. Heid. Inv. G 809. Letter addressed to a beneficiarius. Ankyron, mid 2nd - mid 3rd cent. - 2. P. Heid. Inv. G. 175 recto. Document with a subscription by a curator likely operating in the civil realm. Provenance unknown, late June - mid September, 238.
